subject: Urgent: sustained 5xx and latency from your dedicated pool - account impact
messages:
From: NovaPay Ops <ops@novapay.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-04T22:10:00Z
Subject: Urgent: sustained 5xx and latency from your dedicated pool - account impact

Irene —

We started seeing a sustained spike in 5xx errors and tail latency from requests routed to our dedicated GPU pool starting ~21:45 UTC. Error rate is ~7-9% and p95 latency went from ~120ms to 1.6s. This is affecting customer-facing flows (payment confirmations) and triggering retries across our stack.

Key notes:
- Window: 2028-07-04 21:45 UTC -> ongoing
- Impact: payment confirmation path; visible user failures and elevated timeouts
- We've quarantined a few requests; logs attached (novapay_error_20280704.log)

We have a reserved capacity contract (RWF-3742) and this behavior is putting us at risk of SLA credits. We need an immediate mitigation plan and an ETA for restoring normal latency / error rates. If you can arrange a bridge with your engineering team now that would be ideal.

Please escalate — we are standing by.

— Ravi Menon
Sr. SRE, NovaPay
ops@novapay.com

Attachment: novapay_error_20280704.log (text, 180KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: NovaPay Ops <ops@novapay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-04T22:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: sustained 5xx and latency from your dedicated pool - account impact

Ravi — thanks for the heads up and the log bundle. Really sorry for the disruption. I’m escalating immediately. Proposed next steps:

1) Stand up an ops bridge now (I'll invite infra).
2) Short-term mitigation: we can route a percentage of your traffic to a compatible model variant in another pool while we investigate (this will require authorization for cross-pool burst).
3) Engineering diagnostic: Aditya, can your team confirm whether this is node-level saturation, noisy neighbor eviction, or a scheduling regression? We need live metrics from the dedicated pool (QPS, GPU utilization, queue depth, KV-cache eviction rates).
4) I'll engage our contracts team if we need to discuss SLA relief / credits — please hold off external comms until we have a remediation plan.

Ravi, I'm starting the bridge and authorizing a short burst if it will reduce user-visible failures. ETA for bridge invite: 5 minutes.

Irene Choi
Account Lead — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachment: ops-bridge-notes.txt (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-04T22:37:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: sustained 5xx and latency from your dedicated pool - account impact

Ben / Soojin — forwarding Novapay report. Quick summary from our telemetry (07-04 21:40-22:20 UTC):
- Average GPU utilization on Novapay's pool jumped from 65% -> 96% on a subset of nodes; tail queue depth spiked and token-serve latencies increased.
- KV-cache churn on their hot shard increased ~3x; eviction latency correlates with the p95 increase.
- No obvious kernel regression in the last deploy window; suspect warm-up of a new workload pattern + large burst of long-context requests.

Immediate asks:
- Can infra isolate the hot pods and reduce preemption so their reserved headroom isn't lost to autoscale churn?
- Can we enable an emergency prefix-KV sticky routing for Novapay (short window) to reduce cache churn?
- Prepare a quick model-variant fallback (smaller context, lower token cost) we can route 20% traffic to as a live mitigation.

I’m attaching pool metrics export. If we need to authorize capacity burst, loop in finance/ops for temporary credits.

Thanks — Aditya

Attachment: pool-metrics-07-04.csv (metrics export)

On Thu, Jul 4, 2028 at 22:25 Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai> wrote:

>’m escalating immediately. Proposed next steps:...

From: NovaPay Ops <ops@novapay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal - Novapay <legal@novapay.com>
Date: 2028-07-05T15:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: sustained 5xx and latency from your dedicated pool - account impact

Irene / Aditya — thanks for the quick response and for standing up a plan. We’re on the bridge now with your infra team. A couple quick asks from our side:

- ETA for the sticky routing / isolation changes? Our ops window is tight this afternoon.
- If you route to another pool or a model-variant, we need confirmation of data handling (same PII/KMS boundaries) and whether this will affect our monthly committed throughput billing.

We appreciate the proactive approach. We’ll hold on external comms for now. Legal copied for visibility on SLA clauses if this requires remediation.

— Ravi

Attachment: none
